QuestInfo.name: Queen of the Pixies
QuestInfo.0: You met Lora next to the blue gate in #m200080000#.
QuestInfo.1: Enter the blue gate in #m200080000# and eliminate the Pixiemom.
QuestInfo.2: Lora left with a smile after you defeated Pixiemom. You're meeting all kinds of strange characters these days.

0.0: She was right. You really just do what you're told.\r\n#L0##bHey, doing what you're told is good experience.#l\n#k
0.1: She didn't tell me you were so funny!\r\n#L0##bAnyway, you know Starling? Where is she? She and I need to talk...#l\n#k
0.2: Why should I tell YOU? Jeez, you're annoying. Anyhoo, since you're here, why don't you do me a favor?\r\n#L0##bSure, what can I do for you? (Shoot, I did it again!)#l\n#k
0.3: There's a monster in that gate. I was gonna get it myself, but my jaguar needs to take a catnap. Think you can handle the monster on your own?\r\n#L0##bOf COURSE I can!#l\n#k
0.4: Touchy, touchy! Okay, I'll be here. Go do your stuff.

yes.0: After you do that, maybe I can figure out what's got the Pixies in such a bad mood. Good luck! I think you'll need it.

1.1: I'm a little surprised to see you again, to be honest. You did better than I thought.

mob.0: Weren't you going to fight the monster in the gate? Or are you all talk, after all?
